titel: Australia Sent Machine Guns To Fight Birds

einstellungen.text: Australia sent machine guns to fight birds.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: a lone tall emu stands in a golden wheat field at sunrise and stares straight into the camera, in the far background tiny silhouettes of soldiers with a machine gun on a tripod, cinematic, vertical 9:16, no text
einstellungen.video_prompt: the emu tilts its head and blinks, slow push in, wheat sways in the wind

einstellungen.text: In 1932, about twenty thousand emus were wrecking Western Australian wheat farms.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: wide view over a dusty outback wheat farm with a crooked wire fence, a huge crowd of emus streaming across the golden fields toward the camera, warm afternoon light, vertical 9:16, no people, no text
einstellungen.video_prompt: the emus run through the wheat in a long stream, dust rises, slow aerial glide

einstellungen.text: Soldiers opened fire, but the emus scattered into small groups.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: seen from far behind, two soldiers in old khaki uniforms crouch beside a tripod-mounted machine gun at the edge of a scrubby field, ahead of them many emus run apart in every direction, dust clouds, vertical 9:16, no text, no close-ups of faces
einstellungen.video_prompt: the emus split into small groups and sprint off in all directions, dust swirls, the soldiers stay small and distant

einstellungen.text: A gun jammed, and within weeks the army gave up.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: an old army truck with a machine gun mounted on the back stuck on a bumpy dirt track in the outback, thin smoke rising from the gun, seen from far away, emus walking calmly past in the background, vertical 9:16, no people in focus, no text

einstellungen.text: Machine guns against birds? The birds won.
einstellungen.bild_prompt: a proud emu stands tall on a small dusty hill at golden sunset, chest forward like a victory pose, an abandoned tripod machine gun far behind it, vertical 9:16, cinematic, no people, no text
einstellungen.video_prompt: the emu raises its head proudly and looks into the camera, slow pull back, dust glows in the sunset light
